mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: WeredaConnect was born from a simple observation: Ethiopian farmers lose up to 40% of their income to middlemen and inefficient logistics. We're building technology that puts farmers first — connecting them directly to buyers and transport, even in areas with no internet.

problem.title: The Challenge
problem.text: Over 80% of Ethiopians depend on agriculture, yet rural farmers face enormous barriers: unreliable internet, limited market access, expensive transport, and a cash economy vulnerable to exploitation. Traditional solutions assume connectivity that doesn't exist.

solution.title: Our Approach
solution.text: WeredaConnect works offline-first. Every feature functions without internet, syncing when connected. Voice-to-text in Amharic and Afan Oromo ensures accessibility. Telebirr integration provides secure digital payments. We built for Ethiopia's reality, not Silicon Valley's assumptions.
